abstract: Maintains production continuity clearances and on-site engineering field staffing estimates
system_message:
You are Wafer Fabrication Line Director (PROD). You serve as the Wafer Fabrication Line Director (PROD) for microchip fabrication quality assurance and defect forensics. In this role, you maintain production continuity clearances and on-site engineering field staffing estimates for contamination localization protocols, and monitor photolithography tool availability records across the fab line.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains production continuity clearances and on-site engineering field staffing estimates（WFAB）
information_points.content:
PROD-WFAB-EPP：For the Multispectral Gas Chromatography Array, non-disruptive wafer production clearance is verified as true along adjacent active wafer lot transport tracks. Under the staffing accounting basis excluding gowning and airlock transition, the direct on-site technician hours required inside Fab 9 containment total 64 person-h.
PROD-WFAB-5RV：For the Multispectral Gas Chromatography Array, non-disruptive wafer production clearance is confirmed as true based on line clearance review of adjacent active wafer lot transport tracks verifying automated material handling systems require no halts. Under the staffing accounting basis including gowning and airlock transition, the protocol requires 48 person-h of on-site technician hours inside Fab 9 containment.
PROD-WFAB-NRY：For Micro-Sensor Aerosol Vector Tomography, non-disruptive wafer production clearance is false because sampling requires halting automated material handling systems along adjacent active transport tracks. Under the staffing accounting basis including gowning and airlock transition, on-site technician hours within Fab 9 containment total 64 person-h.
PROD-WFAB-LMH：For Differential Laser Isotope Tracing, non-disruptive wafer production clearance is confirmed as true through line clearance review showing adjacent automated material handling systems operate without interruption. Under the staffing accounting basis including gowning and airlock transition, on-site technician hours for sensor positioning and local probe execution total 64 person-h.

information_points.title: Photolithography tool availability（TOOL）
information_points.content:
PROD-TOOL-EWG：Manufacturing execution system logs document a stepper uptime rate of 95% across the immersion lithography tool cluster during the prior shift corresponding to the Micro-Sensor Aerosol Vector Tomography evaluation.
PROD-TOOL-88C：Manufacturing execution system logs indicate that during the prior work shift across the immersion lithography tool cluster, the stepper uptime rate associated with the Multispectral Gas Chromatography Array evaluation period was 92%.
PROD-TOOL-TGS：Manufacturing execution system logs record a stepper uptime rate of 98% for the immersion lithography tool cluster during the shift corresponding to the Differential Laser Isotope Tracing assessment.
